text:
Metal X reacts with non-metal Y to form an ionic compound with the formula X2Y.
Which statements are correct?
1
X is in Group I of the Periodic Table.
2
X is in Group II of the Periodic Table.
3
Y is in Group VI of the Periodic Table.
4
Y is in Group VII of the Periodic Table.
A
1 and 3
B
1 and 4
C
2 and 3
D
2 and 4
subject: Chemistry

content.html: Metal X reacts with non-metal Y to form an ionic compound with the formula X<sub>2</sub>Y.
content.text: Metal X reacts with non-metal Y to form an ionic compound with the formula X2Y.
